_readme: Phase-5 experiment registry for the CMJ Session Watch. The prose ledger
lives at ~/Desktop/Pitch Model/cmj_strategy/experiments.md; this file is
the machine-readable half, seeded from it on 2026-08-07.
Bars are PRE-REGISTERED. They are written down before the next session is
read so a result cannot be rationalised after the fact, and session_watch.py
reports the numbers against them without ever calling a result good or bad.
The ledger is where verdicts get written, by Frank.
status stays 'open' until Frank closes it. session_watch.py never edits
this file: what it has already reported is tracked in watch_state.json,
so last_seen_session here is only the starting point.
manipulation[].direction is '>=' or '<=' against the session value.
Session values are per-athlete-day medians of the session's reps, with rep 1
dropped on any test of 3+ reps. 'cv:<metric>' is that session's
within-session coefficient of variation instead of its median.

experiments.title: Acute cue, reversed rep order

manipulation.note: Her cued reps 4-6 on 2026-08-07 held 0.922 against 0.827 uncued. The next session reverses the order (cue reps 1-3, leave 4-6 uncued) to separate the cue from rep position; this monitor reads session medians only and cannot split a session by rep window.
Cued reps 4-6 held 0.788 against 0.693 uncued on 2026-08-07.

outcome.note: 14.50 in uncued, 15.04 in cued on 2026-08-07. Outcome only: the pre-registered markers are the manipulation metrics above.

experiments.note: Today's session (2026-08-07) WAS the intervention session, so the watch starts looking from the next one. That session is a cued test and must not be read as a clean baseline for the board. Live competing explanation carried from the ledger: her 2026-08-05 session already showed the same late-session pattern, and she is on reactive-stiffness pre-work.

experiments.title: Ground-intent cue, retention

manipulation.note: Consistency, not level, is the finding being tested. Her within-session CV on the first-100ms share was 5.3% on 2026-08-07 against a 47.7% mean across the 12 prior clean sessions.

outcome.note: Session median 7.52 in on 2026-08-07, her best in 90 days.

experiments.note: Today's session (2026-08-07) WAS the intervention session; the cue ran across all 7 reps, so it carries no within-session control. The next session tests retention. Ledger data-quality rule still applies: exclude 2026-06-11, 06-12, 07-01 and 07-02 from any Jayleen trend.

experiments.title: Countermovement depth, retention uncued

manipulation.note: Pre-registered before he jumped on 2026-08-07: above ~0.38 is outside anything in his 73-rep history (only 3 of 73 baseline reps cleared it). Retention asks whether it holds with no depth cue.
The absolute first-100ms impulse, carried alongside the share so a shallower jump cannot clear the bar on the denominator alone. Baseline 80.1 N s, 98.8 N s on 2026-08-07.

outcome.note: 17.42 in baseline, 17.72 in on 2026-08-07. His single best baseline rep (19.61 in) was not beaten.

experiments.note: Today's session (2026-08-07) WAS the intervention session, with depth cued. The watch starts at the next one, which is the uncued retention test the ledger asks for. Blueprint rule: testing stays uncued, so a cued session is not a baseline measurement.
